summary: The gap between finding a problem and landing the fix, which was the sharpest complaint in the last report, closed almost completely. Five of the six live user-facing breaks named a week ago are fixed and on the default branch, and the sixth is down to one sub-item. Open actions fell 564 to 278 on 353 closures, every one of the ten rotation slots ran on its assigned weekday for the second consecutive week, handler drift is down to a single low finding across eleven files, and the decision pipeline that had zero written briefs now has eight, each with a deadline and a stated default. Against that sit three things. The scheduled-task registry was rebuilt on the night of 2026-08-28 and every approved-permission grant went with it, so sixteen enabled routines now run with an empty permission list. The privacy exposure in the public hub's git history is unchanged and was quietly downgraded from a blocking finding to a deferred medium on 2026-08-27 without the exposure moving. And the week cost $4,590.11 against $2,606.99 the week before, a 76 percent rise with no ceiling anywhere in the system.

topActions.label: Restore the approved-permission grants on the sixteen enabled scheduled tasks and find what rebuilt the registry on 2026-08-28. An unattended routine with an empty permission list stops and waits for a person.

BLOCK: five private artifacts removed from the public hub tree are still fetchable anonymously from its git history. Rule on a history rewrite or a written acceptance, and switch the usage collector to an allow-list in the same pass.
Give each campaign mission an explicit wave cap or win predicate; run_config.gd:71-74 still returns zero, so campaign mode cannot be won.
Spend sessions ruling. Eight briefs are written and dated, fifteen distinct decisions gate roughly two thirds of the backlog, and no routine schedules a session to answer any of them.
Decide what makes a queue item safe for unattended work, then re-enable queue-drain-hourly or retire it. Zero of 29 pending items qualify and the drain has been off since 2026-07-31.
Register the key-value backup task; the contribution endpoint can replace a canonical course record and the newest recoverable snapshot is six days old.
Pull the unlicensed third-party body text out of the public catalog, or replace it with an original summary and a citation.
Make the routine-health watch and the nightly sweep agree on the registry; the same evidence produced opposite conclusions on the same night.
Rule which skill snapshot is authoritative and regenerate from source once; fourteen live-versus-source splits have failed three nights running.
CHRONIC x27: cache the starred slug set and a bounded slice of canonical course records to local storage.
